known_mistakes.male_matches_female: When typing Male in React Select, Female shows first because Female contains male. ALWAYS use exact opt.click() not Enter.
known_mistakes.bobbob_name_doubling: Chrome DevTools fill() appends instead of replacing. Use native value setter: Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, value).set + dispatchEvent.
known_mistakes.dynamic_race_field: After selecting Hispanic=No, a new Please identify your race combobox appears. Must re-scan with max_combo_passes=3.
known_mistakes.disability_wording: Correct text is I do not want to answer (NOT wish). Different companies use: I dont wish to answer, Decline To Self Identify.
known_mistakes.job_board_matches_school: Typing Job Board matches School job board first. Use Other instead.
known_mistakes.recaptcha_vs_email_verification: Some forms that seem blocked by reCAPTCHA actually just need email verification code. Check Gmail for Security code emails.
known_mistakes.textarea_min_length: Some textareas (like AI tools, LLM questions) have minimum character requirements. Use 200+ chars.
known_mistakes.home_dir_assumption: NEVER use ~ or /Users/P3260288/ in CI code. Runner user is rikhsiboevgmail.com on a different laptop. Use script-relative paths: os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
known_mistakes.push_without_verifying_runner_env: BEFORE pushing path changes: ask WHERE does this run? WHO is the user? WHAT is the working directory? Check CI logs for the actual paths.
known_mistakes.greenhouse_api_400: Greenhouse POST API requires each companys API key (Basic Auth). We dont have those keys. ALWAYS fall back to browser (Playwright) when API returns 400. Browser approach is proven: 10 email confirmations Aug 25.
known_mistakes.browser_per_job_loop: NEVER open Playwright browser inside a for-loop (per job). Open ONCE, process ALL jobs in batch. Opening browser = 10s overhead each time.
known_mistakes.import_in_loop: NEVER import heavy modules (playwright, applier) inside a loop. Import ONCE at top or before the batch.
known_mistakes.eu_citizen_field: Company 540 and Affirm ask Are you an EU citizen. Answer is No for Bob (Green Card holder in USA, not EU citizen). Add to SMART_ANSWERS.
known_mistakes.false_positive_submit: submit_and_verify detected URL change as success, but Greenhouse redirects to security code page (NOT real success). Fix: check if new page has security/verification/code text before declaring submitted=True.
known_mistakes.email_verification_not_called: submit_and_verify returns email_verification_required but handle_email_verification at line 1538 is NEVER reached. The retry logic (lines ~1500-1530) retries submit_and_verify again instead of going to the email verification handler at line 1538. Fix: check if reason==email_verification_required INSIDE the retry loop and call handle_email_verification there.

self_hosted_runner_different_user.issue: Self-hosted runner runs as user rikhsiboevgmail.com on OTHER laptop. Home dir is /Users/rikhsiboevgmail.com/ not /Users/P3260288/. Any path using ~ or hardcoded /Users/P3260288/ WILL FAIL.
self_hosted_runner_different_user.fix: ALWAYS use paths relative to the script or GITHUB_WORKSPACE. Never use ~ or hardcoded home paths in CI code.
self_hosted_runner_different_user.rule: BEFORE pushing ANY path change: ask — does this path exist on the RUNNER machine? Check with os.path.dirname(__file__) relative paths ONLY.

resume_path_resolution.issue: resume.pdf in profile.json was relative to agent/ dir but greenhouse_apply.py runs from repo root
resume_path_resolution.fix: profile.json says agent/resume.pdf. Script tries multiple candidates. The file EXISTS in git repo at agent/resume.pdf.
resume_path_resolution.rule: Any file the CI needs MUST be in the git repo or generated during the run. Never depend on local filesystem files.

verify_before_push_checklist: 1. Does this path exist on the RUNNER (user=rikhsiboevgmail.com)?

greenhouse_apply_architecture.problem: greenhouse_apply.py tried API POST which needs company API keys we dont have. Gets HTTP 400 on ALL jobs.
greenhouse_apply_architecture.solution: When API returns 400 → immediately try browser strategy via run_applications() from applier.py

greenhouse_apply_flow.correct_flow: 1. API tries all jobs fast (1s each, will get 400). 2. Collect all API-failed URLs. 3. Open Playwright ONCE. 4. Process all failed jobs in ONE browser session. 5. Close browser.
greenhouse_apply_flow.wrong_flow: Opening browser for each job inside the loop = 10s overhead x 30 jobs = 5 min wasted on browser startups alone.
